rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3AB blastocyst and appropriately notes possible partial collapse/re-expansion, compact ICM, and less cohesive TE, but includes speculative details (exact visible cell counts, excluded cells/debris, zona comments) that may not be reliably supported by a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, response to stimulation, male factor, BMI, endometrium, first-cycle status, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and mostly consistent, linking morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor overreach appears in some morphology-specific inferences and broad probability framing.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: supports single embryo transfer, avoids routine add-ons, treats PGT-A as optional in a young patient, and appropriately contextualizes fresh transfer and male-factor workup.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, lifestyle, avoidance of unnecessary adjuncts, and future planning including male-factor refinement and when to consider PGT-A or freeze-all.
